16:   bffApi->>relationalDb: BEGIN TX; INSERT staged recipe_versions/schedule_configs (DRAFT -> PENDING_PUBLISH); INSERT governance_tickets (status=PENDING_APPROVAL); INSERT audit_log_entries; COMMIT

20:   bffApi->>relationalDb: BEGIN TX; SELECT governance_tickets, report_definitions FOR UPDATE

24:     relationalDb-->>bffApi: true (In-flight run detected)
25:     bffApi->>relationalDb: ROLLBACK status change; INSERT audit_log_entries (outcome=DENIED_EXECUTION_FREEZE)
